feature: Decouple brainstorming from the pipeline: brainstorming writes a complete plan.json; expected_red is replaced by a deterministic RED-form check plus coder reason pre-approval, with the revisor as the sole semantic guarantee; the task-generator becomes a punctual corrective/arbitrate/closing owner.
global_constraints: All artifacts are English-only; UI copy keeps the product's established locale.
The script never reads the calling session's context - only the plan file and the ledger.
Every LLM-invoked command runs through scripts/cmd (RTK-compressed stdout; full output to files).
Workers never commit; Script CEO commits.
touches lists implementation paths only - test paths are the RED (changed minus touches) and must never appear in touches.
Task order is mandatory: the form checker lands first, then coder-gate consumes it, then brief-scaffold stops emitting expected_red. Reversing this breaks every brief scaffolded in between.
This branch is executed by the pre-change pipeline, so every task still carries expected_red for bootstrap; the new scripts ignore it once they land.

tasks.title: Add the deterministic RED-form checker
tasks.summary: Create scripts/red-form-check, a deterministic per-language classifier that reads the operador's machine-readable RED evidence and decides whether it is a valid red (suite loaded, at least one test executed, failed as an assertion or runtime error). Compile/load reds are invalid. This is the script-side replacement for the expected_red grep and an additive first step.
acceptance: red-form-check exits 0 when the evidence shows an executed test that failed as an assertion or runtime error
red-form-check exits 1 when the evidence shows a suite load/compile error with no executed test
red-form-check exits 1 when the evidence file is missing
red-form-check exits 2 for an unsupported language or bad usage
the checker is deterministic and makes no LLM call
tasks.expected_red: red-form-check must accept an executed assertion failure

tasks.title: Make coder-gate validate RED form instead of expected_red
tasks.summary: Replace coder-gate's expected_red lookup and substring grep with a call to red-form-check. A missing or invalid form is a FAIL round with a dedicated fix prompt; TEST_DEFECT remains terminal. After this the plan no longer needs expected_red.
acceptance: coder-gate no longer reads expected_red from plan.json
a form-valid RED is accepted even when the plan carries no expected_red
a form-invalid RED produces a FAIL round and a fix prompt, not a TEST_DEFECT
TEST_DEFECT in the operador's final status line still escalates and stops the loop
tasks.expected_red: coder-gate must accept a form-only RED

tasks.title: Drop expected_red from brief-scaffold and require reason pre-approval
tasks.summary: brief-scaffold stops requiring expected_red and drops the Expected-failure section. The brief instead instructs the operador to save the RED run in the runner's machine-readable format and to declare and confirm the expected reason before implementing. The test-like touches guard stays.
acceptance: a task without expected_red scaffolds successfully
the brief contains no Expected-failure section and contains the reason-declaration and machine-readable-evidence instructions
test-like touches still cause exit 2
the brief still lists acceptance and spec_refs

tasks.title: Remove EXPAND and make task ownership punctual in run-pipeline
tasks.summary: tasks_usable checks acceptance only and the expand dispatch is removed. Corrective and arbitrate dispatch the task-generator fresh with findings plus the full plan path plus the target task and its spec_refs, resuming only within the episode. Closing remains a curated one-shot package. No cross-branch task-generator session is reused.
acceptance: a complete plan without expected_red runs with no expand dispatch
a corrective or arbitrate dispatch passes the plan path and the target task
the task-generator session is not reused across tasks
closing still builds the curated package and dispatches the task-generator once
tasks.expected_red: run-pipeline must not require expected_red in the plan

tasks.title: Update tier agent definitions and prompts for the new roles
tasks.summary: two-model-task-generator loses EXPAND and documents punctual corrective/arbitrate/closing with script-controlled context. two-model-coder declares the expected reason before implementing, saves the machine-readable RED, and no longer references a brief expected-failure string.
acceptance: the task-generator definition and prompt contain no EXPAND mode and document the controlled context for corrective, arbitrate and closing
the coder definition and prompt instruct saving a machine-readable RED and declaring and confirming the reason before implementing
no prompt references the brief's expected-failure text

Record ADR-0008 and update CONTEXT.md, README.txt and README-LLM.md.

README.txt and README-LLM.md reflect the change
